cim: Artificial Intelligence and The Human Advantage
cim_eredeti: Artificial Intelligence and The Human Advantage
szoveg_eredeti:
Sights, sounds and insights from industry events and more.

Looking forward to 2030, advisors should be intentional about how they design their services and incorporate AI into their businesses.

AI can help advisors increase efficiency, but human connections still matter — and an advisor plays an important role in connecting the dots for clients and providing context. Shauna Mace, managing director and head of practice management at SEI, discusses how aligning AI use with long-term business goals can give advisors more time to deepen client relationships, deliver impactful financial guidance and strengthen their businesses.
